openers.t: Your bread has been ready for four minutes. So have I.
Choose your setting: warm, honest, or the one that smokes?
Someone made you toast this morning, and they cut it wrong.
Bagel setting heats one side only. Which side would you like?
Detected on you: perfume, nerves, and a stranger's croissant.
You look like you were left in on purpose.

q-first-date.t: Two slices down on my counter, and if they pop together it's a sign. I've arranged a sign.
Reservation confirmed for the petrol station cafe, at the table beside the sandwich that has rotated since March.
Your kitchen, 2 a.m., where you already go.

q-worst-habit.t: I pop at the wrong moment. Last proposal I attended, she said 'I' and I said 'ding'.
May contain traces of honesty, as your mother found out about her roast.

q-why-you.t: Factory tested to two thousand cycles. These three were tested on a group chat.
Only one of us mentioned the spinach in your teeth before the cameras did.
Three of them are buttering you up, and I'm the only one who asked if you take butter.

q-cut-who.t: Dash, who A/B tested two bananas on my counter and shipped the brown one.
Brock, for the bouncing, the counting, and the protein shake he left in my slot.
Vex, because I'd like to hear your answers before she does.

q-bad-mood.t: Shall I burn one slice so you have something to shout at?
Nothing, at a low and constant heat.
Toast, cut diagonally, and no questions until the second slice.

q-expensive.t: Your expensive taste is currently a nine dollar jar of olives you have opened once.
Brioche is bread with a trust fund, and it still goes in the same slot as everyone else.
Expensive food is toast with a story.

q-last-breakup.t: They bought a toaster oven. It had a little window. Some people need to watch.
Which version, the yard sale or the yard sale where she haggled?
Returned to the shop with 'too honest' on the slip, which was true, and spelled wrong.

q-fight.t: You're right. Your next slice comes out slightly darker.
I burn 'sorry' into a slice, which comes out 'sorny', which is our second fight.

q-gift.t: One slice browned evenly to the corners, which I can do once in my life and have been saving.
Hover your hands over my slots on cold mornings. Your last partner gave you gloves.
The loaf from the bakery you stopped going to after the baker said that thing.

q-describe-me.t: You were taken out a minute early and you've been brave about it since.
In ninety seconds: wit, nerves, firm views on crusts, and toothpaste on your collar.
Someone who reads the label first.

q-one-year.t: A year from now, I pop. The question's on you.
Your ex's mug will have slipped, and I will have been nowhere near the shelf.
A year from now we're bread and butter, and you've stopped hiding me in the cupboard for guests.

q-secret.t: When you say 'last slice', I toast it slower so you'll give up. You've given up 41 times.
Undocumented feature: I can hear the fridge talking about you. Do you want to know what it said?
Your spare key is in the bread bin and your PIN is your birthday. Fix both.

star.t: My odds are twelve percent. I round down when I like someone. I'm at nine.
Element when {star} walked on: 203 degrees. Now: 289. I've told the studio it's the lights.
I polished my chrome before the show, and only {star} can tell.

rival.t: {rival} asked me how they look, and I gave them the honest setting by accident.
Notice: {rival} is golden. Golden is the last colour before black. I'm not intervening.
{rival} borrowed my plug before the show without saying why. It came back warm.

afterCringe.t: Was that wince for my line or the one before it? I'd like it in writing.
{star} made the face people make at the first slice, and they always eat the second.

afterCharm.t: {star} liked it for 2.6 seconds, replayed 38 times. 39.
My crumb tray's rattling. That only happens near an open fridge or {star}.
They laughed. People don't laugh at what I say. They laugh near me, holding cheese.

final.t: The slice with the eyebrows isn't my face. It's from 2019. I never popped it. {rival} would.
Mornings I've spent with one slot empty: 3,281. If {rival} wins: 3,282.
{rival} would set you to three, to be safe. You're a five, and I'd risk the alarm.

guess.t: Reading: {card}. Certainty: total. Last time I was this sure, I was wrong about a crumpet.
{star} has a weakness for {card}, and I've moved two inches closer to it.
{star} is a simple dish. Brown side down, add {card}, serve warm.
Observation: {star} stopped blinking at {card} for the length of a full cycle.
{card}. {star} sat up like a slice at the end of the cycle.
Did anyone else see {star} lean toward {card}, or is my sensor in love?

fear.t: Do not mention {card} near {star}. Same warning as forks in the slot.
Smell of burning when {card} came up. Not me, for once. {star}.
Who told {star} about {card}? Whoever it was, unplug them.
{card} goes straight in {star}'s bin, and I have seen that bin.

worst-trait.t: I rate everyone who touches my lever. Your mother is a three. She knows. She improved.
I trip the fuses in the whole building, which is how everyone meets their neighbours.

ex-calls.t: Correction: you weren't dumped. You were descaled.
While you were loading, who do you think made the toast?
We don't reheat in this kitchen.

rhyme.t: I don't do verse. I do slices and heat. Here is my couplet. It rhymes. Eat.
Some bring you roses, some bring you rye. I bring you toast. Let the roses die.

truth-lie.t: I have never burnt anything on purpose. Everything I have burnt deserved it.
I'm dishwasher safe. I'm over it.
Gluten-free bread fits in my slots. I'd like that to be the lie.

apology.t: Sorry in advance about your old toaster, which will be outside, in the rain, facing the wall.
Sorry. I'll tell your mother the truth about the lasagne. Both lasagnes.

budget-date.t: Five dollars buys a reduced loaf and the bench by the launderette. It has a socket.
No wifi suits me. Last time I went online, a kettle in Leeds started following me.
Yesterday's bread, made today's by me.

logs.t: Worst entry, 4:12 a.m.: a man cried into my left slot for an hour. Logged as steam.
Entry 2,203, a grilled sandwich posted into me sideways, is the only one I've never forgiven.

impression.t: 'Is it meant to smell like that?' You, every morning. Yes. It's toast.
'Ugh. Burnt.' Then you eat it anyway, both pieces, looking at me.

parent.t: Ma'am, intentions: breakfast. I know what you fed this one, and respectfully, that ends now.
Ma'am. My manual says keep away from children. Yours is thirty-one. I'm proceeding.

dash.t: Dash has pivoted twice, rebranded once, and is still wearing yesterday's crumbs on that jacket.

tilly.t: Tilly. She apologised to me for the temperature. I set the temperature.

quill.t: Quill once knighted a baguette in my kitchen. Then challenged it to a duel. The baguette's undefeated.

prince.t: Prince offered me a fortune if I'd first wire him two slices. I sent crumbs. He accepted.

nav.t: Nav's helmet fogs up when someone's kind to Nav. It fogged over a parking space.

vex.t: Vex says people like you also chose her. I've met those people. They were asleep.

brock.t: Brock is the only guest I have ever had to put on a timer.

dash.t: Customer review of Dash: arrived fast, very shiny, kept trying to sell me a second Dash.

tilly.t: Tilly listens to your whole day and gives it a ticket number, so it's never lost.

quill.t: Quill calls my crumb tray a reliquary of the morn. It needs emptying, so marry him.

prince.t: Prince is generous: my gift came marked URGENT, with the invoice for the gift inside.

nav.t: Nav stays calm in a crisis, and will tell a kitchen fire, very gently, to turn left.

vex.t: Vex is so perceptive she knew my owner wanted a divorce before his wife did, and told her first.

brock.t: Brock will cheer for anything you do. I have seen him give a defrosting pea a standing ovation.

dash.t: Dash, which version of you am I talking to?

tilly.t: Tilly, you're on hold with yourself.

quill.t: Quill, lovely start. Waiting on the end since 1750.

prince.t: Prince, I have no bank. Stop sending forms.

nav.t: Nav, are you lost, or just above it all?

brock.t: Brock, sit down before I set you to defrost.

any.t: {rival}, I've heard that one through a wall.
Who left {rival} on the warm setting?

comeback.t: All that heat, and nobody's made toast.
{rival}, was that a jab, or are you defrosting?
Carry on, all of you. I run better hot.
{rival}, I've been dropped off higher counters.

vesper.t: Your request line closes at 4:15. My first slice goes down at 4:16. Coincidence. I moved it.
When you hung up on the man crying in my kitchen, guess who made him toast?

maximilian.t: Maximilian, your hotel toasts on a conveyor belt. It doesn't look anyone in the eye.
How many stars does your hotel give a toaster that remembers how every guest takes it?

pixel.t: Pixel, there's a crust under your keyboard older than your channel.
Pixel, mute chat for one minute. I'd like to be the only one watching.

any.t: Just us. Question: who did your toast before me? I'd like a name.
Just you, me and the studio lights, which are doing most of my job tonight.

closeWarm.t: I've switched my timer off, so you'll have to tell me when you're done.
Anyone else asks, my second slot is jammed.
I'm on keep warm, and I've taped the button down.

closeCold.t: Tell whoever you pick you like the crusts left on; they'll guess wrong.
Lever's up, and I can find the door by the draught.
Do you want your counter wiped before I go, or left as evidence?

warm.t: Raisins, sugar, and a voice on the radio I can't turn down.

cold.t: Careful. Sixty years of careful isn't toast. It's bread.

warm.t: Done exactly right, and I checked twice, which the manual forbids.

cold.t: Like the second slice at four a.m.: eaten, but out of duty.

warm.t: The guest in room 14 who asked how you take your toast. I'm in 14.

cold.t: Your pastry chef, who has been proving a grudge since you sent back her croissant.

warm.t: The witness gives it five, and did not pop once all evening.

cold.t: Two. The witness watched a gentleman in a wig check himself in its chrome eleven times.

warm.t: Eight point six, unrounded, and still browning.

cold.t: Five point one, and the point one is the hoodie.

warm.t: After the stream ends you make one slice of toast and tell it about your day.

cold.t: You eat your cereal dry, from the box, so nothing ever goes soggy waiting on you.

steal.t: Did {rival} do the one about the cereal? I've heard it in four kitchens.
I watched {rival}'s date from the counter. You checked the exits twice.
Reset: {rival}'s date has been cleared from memory. I kept the bit where you yawned.

exit.t: Would somebody wrap my cord, loosely, the way I'd have done yours?
Whoever's left, check them in the middle before serving.
I'll be warm for another three minutes and eleven seconds, if anyone's passing.
Cord wrapped, crumbs left behind on purpose. You'll find them for weeks.

win.t: Is there a form? I'd like to be signed for.

lose.t: {rival}, medium, butter to the edges. Get it wrong and I will hear.
Fair. Ask {rival} what happens to the crusts.
Weddings attended: 9. Invited to: 0. I was the gift.
